about.title: Witan Thailand
about.lead: The Thailand subsidiary of Witan Company — a Korean cosmetics partner with a decade of cross-border experience.

story.title: Built between Seoul and Bangkok.
story.p1: Witan Company was founded in Korea to bridge the gap between K-beauty laboratories and global brands. After years of helping international clients navigate Korean manufacturing, we opened Witan Thailand to bring that capability closer to one of Asia's fastest-growing beauty markets.
story.p2: From our Bangkok office we serve Thai brands, distributors, and entrepreneurs who want the quality of Korean cosmetics — without the complexity of managing it from abroad.

v1.title: One Accountable Partner
v1.desc: Replace five vendors with one team that owns the entire pipeline — from raw material to delivered product.

v2.title: Korean Quality, Thai Speed
v2.desc: Korean lab-grade R&D and QC, paired with Thailand-aware MOQs, lead times, and regulatory know-how.

v3.title: Three Languages, No Friction
v3.desc: We work in Thai, English, and Korean — every contract, every spec sheet, every conversation.

services.title: Six services. One workflow.
services.lead: Pick the services you need — or hand us the entire pipeline.

rnd.title: R&D · Ingredient Development
rnd.lead: Custom actives and formulations developed with our Korean R&D partners.
rnd.p1: We co-develop cosmetic actives and finished formulations with Korean research institutes and contract labs. Whether you need a proprietary peptide, a botanical extract, or a fully formulated serum, we run the project end-to-end — from concept brief to stability-tested final spec.
features: Korean Patent and KFDA functional ingredient pathway support

materials.title: Material Sales
materials.lead: Direct supply of Korean cosmetic raw materials and packaging.
materials.p1: Skip the trader markup. We supply Korean-origin actives, extracts, fragrances, and packaging components directly from manufacturers — with full COA, MSDS, and regulatory documentation.
features: Functional actives (peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, etc.)
Full documentation: COA, MSDS, regulatory sheets

oem.title: OEM / ODM Small-Batch Platform
oem.lead: Launch a brand with 1,000-unit MOQs. Korean factories, Thai-friendly terms.
oem.p1: Most Korean OEMs require 5,000–10,000 units per SKU. We aggregate orders across our partner factory network so Thai brands can launch real Korean-made products with as few as 1,000 units.
features: Skincare, suncare, color, haircare, body, fragrance

fda.title: Thai FDA Registration
fda.lead: End-to-end Thai FDA notification and compliance.
fda.p1: Thai FDA cosmetic notification requires the right local entity, full ingredient disclosure, GMP documentation, and Thai-language labeling. We handle all of it — including the parts most foreign brands miss.
features: Ingredient list review and prohibited substance check

clinical.title: Korean Clinical Testing
clinical.lead: CRO-grade efficacy and safety claims through Korean clinical institutes.
clinical.p1: "Clinically proven in Korea" is one of the strongest claims in Asian beauty. We run efficacy and human safety studies through accredited Korean CROs — with study design, statistical analysis, and claim language reviewed for Thai regulatory use.
features: Efficacy claims: hydration, anti-wrinkle, brightening, soothing, etc.
Bilingual reports usable in Thai marketing

logistics.title: Korea → Thailand Logistics
logistics.lead: Sea and air freight, customs, and last-mile delivery into Thai retail.
logistics.p1: Cosmetics ship under specific HS codes, temperature limits, and FDA documentation requirements. Our logistics team — based in both Seoul and Bangkok — handles the entire route, including bonded warehousing and Thai retail distribution.
features: Sea LCL/FCL and air freight from Korea
Cosmetics-aware export packing and HS code handling
Thai customs clearance and FDA cross-check
Last-mile delivery to Thai retail, e-commerce 3PL

process.title: How a project runs.
process.lead: From the first brief to the first shipment — typically 90 to 180 days.

s1.title: Brief
s1.desc: You share product idea, target market, MOQ, and budget. NDA on request.

s2.title: Roadmap
s2.desc: We return a 48-hour roadmap: services needed, factory match, timeline, cost.

s3.title: R&D / Sourcing
s3.desc: Formula development or material sourcing. Sample sent to your office.

s4.title: Pilot Production
s4.desc: Small-batch pilot run, QC inspection, stability and clinical testing if needed.

s5.title: FDA & Labeling
s5.desc: Thai FDA notification filed in parallel with Thai-language label design.

s6.title: Mass Production
s6.desc: Full Korean factory run with QC and pre-shipment inspection.

s7.title: Logistics
s7.desc: Sea/air freight, customs clearance, bonded warehouse arrival in Bangkok.

s8.title: Delivery
s8.desc: Last-mile to your Thai warehouse, retail DC, or e-commerce 3PL.
